svg.title: How sedge works
svg.desc: Channels, signals, timers and the terminal put events into the inbox. It starts a run on pi-durable, which works with memory, skills, MCP servers, tools and approvals. What the run sends leaves through the outbox to you on your channel, and your reply comes back as an event.
svg.text: your reply comes back as an event
pi-durable · a conversation per thread · resumes after a restart
